text: Mehwish Zafar holds account PK**HABB****1661 which was opened on 26 October 2025. The subject is a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 April 2026 and 11 April 2026 the account received 28 credits totalling PKR 1,450,000 and made 6 debits totalling PKR 1,306,000. All 28 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 23 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 11 April 2026, scoring a Tazama typology MULE-01 of 360 against a threshold of 300. Many unrelated inbound senders (23 distinct) in a short period is consistent with the money mule activity hypothesis. Credits were 58.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000, inconsistent with the subject’s student profile, aligning with the money mule activity hypothesis. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 849,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 457,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 3 transactions. Screening on 29 April 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
